cards.title: Bring your agent code. Foundry runs it.
cards.body: Package any framework as a container. Foundry adds a dedicated Entra identity and endpoint, per-session isolation and scale to zero. Start with the Responses protocol.

link.label: Hosted agents in Foundry Agent Service

cards.title: From sample to hosted agent with azd ai agent
cards.body: Use init to start from a sample, run to test locally, azd deploy to build it in Foundry, invoke to call it and monitor to stream logs. Needs azd 1.32.0 or later.

cards.title: The next generation of Semantic Kernel and AutoGen
cards.body: Combines AutoGen's simple agents with Semantic Kernel's enterprise features. Use agents for open-ended tasks and graph-based workflows for explicit control.

cards.title: Embed Copilot's agent runtime in your own app
cards.body: Same engine as Copilot CLI: planning, tool calls, custom agents and skills. With BYOK it runs on Microsoft Foundry models, no Copilot subscription needed.

cards.title: Chain turns by ID instead of resending history
cards.body: One stateful API that brings together chat completions and Assistants. Stream output, call functions and remote MCP servers, and run long tasks in background mode.

link.label: Use the Azure OpenAI Responses API

cards.title: Define tools once, serve them from one MCP endpoint
cards.body: Toolbox centralizes auth, guardrails, observability and versioning for your tools. Any MCP client can connect, and tools change without agent code changes.

link.label: What is Toolbox in Microsoft Foundry?

cards.title: Ground agents in your data, with citations
cards.body: Foundry IQ knowledge bases span Blob, SharePoint, OneLake and the web. Agentic retrieval runs parallel subqueries, enforces user permissions and cites sources.

cards.title: Let a router choose the model for each prompt
cards.body: Model router picks the most suitable LLM per prompt in real time, behind one deployment. Choose Balanced, Cost or Quality mode and an optional model subset.

cards.title: Unit tests for agents, scored Pass/Fail
cards.body: Built-in evaluators check end-to-end outcomes (Task Adherence, Intent Resolution) and each step (Tool Call Accuracy, Tool Selection). Several are in preview.

cards.title: Shift left: attack your agent before you deploy
cards.body: The AI Red Teaming Agent uses open-source PyRIT for automated adversarial scans scored by Attack Success Rate. Cloud runs add agent risks like sensitive data leakage.

cards.title: Put guardrails on tool calls, not just chat
cards.body: Agent guardrails (preview) check user input and output, plus tool calls and tool responses, for harmful content and attacks. Hosted agents add egress controls (preview).

cards.title: Find which step caused the error or latency spike
cards.body: Traces record inputs, outputs, tool usage, retries, latency and cost via OpenTelemetry, stored in Application Insights. GA for prompt and hosted agents.

cards.title: An Entra identity type built for AI agents
cards.body: Foundry integrates with Microsoft Entra Agent ID and creates agent identities for you. Tool calls use automatic token exchange, so no secrets sit in prompts or code.

cards.title: Drop the API keys. Use Microsoft Entra ID.
cards.body: Use DefaultAzureCredential with managed identities, assign the Cognitive Services User role on the Foundry resource, then disable key-based authentication.

cards.title: Meet users in Microsoft Copilot and Teams
cards.body: Publishing from the Foundry portal creates the Azure Bot Service resource and Teams app package. Scope it to just you instantly, or to your org after admin approval.

link.label: Publish to Microsoft Copilot and Teams

cards.title: Define what and why before deciding how
cards.body: GitHub Spec Kit turns requirements into a spec, plan and tasks, then guides implementation against them. Run each /speckit-* skill in your agent's chat.

cards.title: Define the process in code, let agents do the work
cards.body: Dynamic workflows (public preview) mix automated steps and agents in sequence or parallel, pause at checkpoints for review, then resume. In Copilot app, CLI and SDK.

cards.title: Keep scoring your agent on live traffic
cards.body: Continuous evaluation samples live traffic. The Agent Monitoring Dashboard (preview) shows token usage, latency, run success rate, eval scores and red team results.
